question: 既參觀過2009年之前開放的博物館又參觀過2011年之後開放的博物館的遊客的名字是什麼？
gold_sql: SELECT t1.name FROM visitor AS t1 JOIN visit AS t2 ON t1.id  =  t2.visitor_id JOIN museum AS t3 ON t3.Museum_ID  =  t2.Museum_ID WHERE t3.open_year  <  2009 INTERSECT SELECT t1.name FROM visitor AS t1 JOIN visit AS t2 ON t1.id  =  t2.visitor_id JOIN museum AS t3 ON t3.Museum_ID  =  t2.Museum_ID WHERE t3.open_year  >  2011
pred_sql:
SELECT DISTINCT v.Name
FROM visitor v
JOIN visit vi ON v.ID = vi.visitor_ID
JOIN museum m ON vi.Museum_ID = m.Museum_ID
WHERE v.ID IN (
    SELECT vi2.visitor_ID
    FROM visit vi2
    JOIN museum m2 ON vi2.Museum_ID = m2.Museum_ID
    WHERE CAST(m2.Open_Year AS INTEGER) < 2009
)
AND v.ID IN (
    SELECT vi3.visitor_ID
    FROM visit vi3
    JOIN museum m3 ON vi3.Museum_ID = m3.Museum_ID
    WHERE CAST(m3.Open_Year AS INTEGER) > 2011
)

steps.raw:
SELECT DISTINCT v.Name
FROM visitor v
JOIN visit vi ON v.ID = vi.visitor_ID
JOIN museum m ON vi.Museum_ID = m.Museum_ID
WHERE v.ID IN (
    SELECT vi2.visitor_ID
    FROM visit vi2
    JOIN museum m2 ON vi2.Museum_ID = m2.Museum_ID
    WHERE CAST(m2.Open_Year AS INTEGER) < 2009
)
AND v.ID IN (
    SELECT vi3.visitor_ID
    FROM visit vi3
    JOIN museum m3 ON vi3.Museum_ID = m3.Museum_ID
    WHERE CAST(m3.Open_Year AS INTEGER) > 2011
);
